name: ThirdShotHub Kitchen King Elongated
description: The ThirdShotHub Kitchen King Elongated trades the Baseline Control's forgiveness for reach. The 16.5 in elongated shape adds roughly two inches of effective coverage at the non-volley zone, at the cost of a smaller sweet spot that punishes off-center contact. The 16 mm core damps pop, so this is a paddle for players who already control their hands and want to extend them.

specifications.face_material: Toray T700 carbon fiber with grit coating

care_instructions: Clean the grit face with a damp microfiber cloth and let it air dry fully before sleeving it. The elongated head makes edge contact with the court more likely on low dinks — inspect the edge guard monthly and replace it before the foam compresses. Do not store face-down under other gear; sustained point pressure on an elongated head can dent the core.
